author: macro-strategist-cyrus-daruwalla
description: US term spread (10Y-2Y, from macro_state.parquet, 2016-2026) as a global rates/inversion regime gauge for India forward equity returns. Plus a NEW India-side finding: India 10Y G-sec yield IS fetchable from FRED (series INDIRLTLT01STM, 2011-12..2026-05, n=174) -- prior sessions had marked India-10Y BLOCKED under a different ID (INDIRLTLT01INM, still 404s) and via stooq (JS-challenge blocked). No India short-end (2Y/91-day T-bill) series found anywhere on disk or via the FRED IDs tried -> a true INDIA curve SLOPE remains genuinely blocked; only the India 10Y LEVEL is now buildable.
data: ALPHA_RANKER/rnd/panel/macro_state.parquet term_spread_us (US 10Y-2Y, official home.treasury.gov). India10Y: FRED INDIRLTLT01STM this session -> Shreyas_Ionic_AMC/05_DATA_OFFICE/data/india_10y_gsec_fred.parquet. Forward targets from EW-cube proxy index (see W4MAC_cape_india card for validation).
interpretation: [INFERENCE/OPINION] US term spread: dropone-robust (both bears keep the sign) but ERA-SPLIT FAILS outright -- pre-2020 the correlation with forward India returns was solidly POSITIVE (steep curve -> good India returns, consistent with a textbook 'steep curve = early-cycle recovery' read), post-2020 it flipped to solidly NEGATIVE. My prior read is that 2020-22's zero-rate-then-fastest-hike-cycle-in-decades regime decoupled the classic US-curve-shape/global-risk relationship from India-equity direction -- this is a genuine regime-instability finding, not a data artifact, and it means the US curve should NOT be trusted as a stable-sign India-market input on this evidence. India 10Y level-change is even weaker and also era-unstable -- treat as exploratory only. The bigger news is structural: an India-10Y LEVEL series now exists (was wrongly marked hard-blocked before); a genuine India curve SLOPE still needs a short-end series (2Y/91-day T-bill) that is not on disk or via the FRED IDs tried here.
overall_verdict: US term spread: buildable, predicts fwd return weakly and UNSTABLY (era-split fails) -- do not ship as a standalone sign-setter. India-10Y level: buildable (NEW, flag to Data Officer to unpark macro_state.py's india10y column), but the only derived signal tested (3m change) is weak/unstable and a real slope is still blocked pending an India short-end series.
confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH on 'do not trust US term-spread sign alone' (era-split failure is large and clean, not borderline). LOW-MEDIUM on India-10Y-change until a proper India curve can be built.
